This petition was called on for hearing today.

Hon'Ble Mr. Justice C.T. Ravikumar
 For Petitioner(s) Ms. Binu Tamta, Aor
 For Respondent(s)

Upon hearing the counsel the Court made the following
 O R D E R

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that before the High Court it was a specific case that possession of the land in question which could not be taken over even as on the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (the 2013 Act, for short) due to the State.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is also submitted that as observed by this court in the case of Indore Development Authority vs. Manoharlal and Others reported in (2020)8 SCC 129, there shall not be any lapse of acquisition under Section 24(2) of the Act of 2013.
